overview: The MSME Industry 4.0 Adoption Scheme is designed to support micro, small, and medium enterprises in adopting advanced technologies under Industry 4.0, including automation, IoT, AI, and digital transformation, to enhance productivity, competitiveness, and sustainability. The scheme provides financial and technical assistance for technology upgradation, skill development, and integration of smart manufacturing systems. It aims to strengthen the MSME sector’s readiness for future industrial trends and global value chains.
objectives: Promote adoption of Industry 4.0 technologies such as IoT, AI, robotics, and automation in MSMEs
Enhance productivity, quality, and operational efficiency through digital transformation
Support skill development and workforce training in emerging technologies
Facilitate integration of smart manufacturing systems and data-driven decision-making
Improve market competitiveness and readiness for global value chains
Encourage sustainable and energy-efficient manufacturing practices
Strengthen backward and forward linkages through technology-enabled collaboration
eligibility: Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises with valid Udyam Registration Certificate (URC) are eligible to apply. The enterprise must be engaged in manufacturing or service activities and demonstrate a viable project plan for technology adoption under Industry 4.0. Priority may be given to enterprises in aspirational districts, SC/ST/women-led units, and those showing potential for scalability and employment generation.
benefits: Financial subsidy for technology acquisition and implementation, technical guidance for digital transformation, access to expert consultation and training programs, support for pilot projects and proof-of-concept development, assistance in integrating IoT, AI, and automation systems, and facilitation of market linkages through technology-enabled platforms.
financial_support: The scheme provides a capital subsidy of up to 50% of the project cost for eligible technology adoption initiatives, with a maximum ceiling of INR 25 lakhs per enterprise. The remaining 50% of the project cost is to be borne by the beneficiary. Funds are disbursed in installments based on project milestones and verification of implementation.
application_process: 1. Visit the official MSME portal at https://msme.gov.in and navigate to the Schemes and Services section. 2. Locate the MSME Industry 4.0 Adoption Scheme and click on 'Apply Now'. 3. Register on the portal using Udyam Registration Number and create a login profile. 4. Fill in the online application form with enterprise details, project proposal, and technology adoption plan. 5. Upload required documents including Udyam Certificate, project report, quotations, and bank details. 6. Submit the application and await preliminary screening. 7. Shortlisted applications will undergo technical evaluation by the empowered committee. 8. Upon approval, the applicant will be notified and required to submit ack of subsidy will be initiated in phases based on project progress and verification.
required_documents: Project Report detailing technology adoption plan
Quotations or invoices from technology vendors
Bank account details and cancelled cheque
Audited financial statements for the last two years (if available)
Undertaking regarding non-availing of similar subsidy from other sources
deadlines: Rolling basis — applications are accepted throughout the year subject to availability of funds.
implementing_agency: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
caveats: Subsidy is disbursed on reimbursement basis after verification of technology installation and utilization
Enterprises must ensure that the adopted technology is new and not previously used
The scheme does not cover routine maintenance, software licenses, or operational expenses
Funds are limited and subject to availability; early application is advised
Beneficiary must retain and maintain the adopted technology for a minimum of three years
